nodes.description: rhinoToken._name stores the ERC20 token name 'Rhino Protocol'.
rhinoToken._symbol stores the ERC20 token symbol 'Rhino'.
rhinoToken._decimals stores the token decimals (18).
rhinoToken._totalSupply is the initial minted supply (1_000_000 * 1e18) minted to the owner in the constructor.
rhinoToken._horn_pool is the address that receives half of every transfer fee; writable from the constructor and changeHornPool.
rhinoToken.total_collected accumulates the in-contract portion of fees until a lottery payout is triggered.
rhinoToken.last_transacters is an address[] ring of the last senders used to pick a lottery winner.
ERC20._balances mapping of account balances, mutated by _transfer, _mint and the randomize payout.
ERC20._allowances nested mapping of owner->spender allowances, mutated by _approve.
ERC20._totalSupply accounting variable incremented by _mint.
rhinoToken constructor: sets _horn_pool and mints the whole supply to tokenOwnerAddress.
rhinoToken.transfer overrides ERC20 transfer: takes a 2% fee, splits it between _horn_pool and the contract, then calls randomize.
rhinoToken.randomize internal: accumulates fees, and every 10 senders pays the collected balance to a pseudo-randomly selected previous sender.
rhinoToken.getRandom internal: derives an index from keccak256(now, msg.sender) % 9, a predictable on-chain randomness source.
rhinoToken.changeHornPool: requires msg.sender == hardcoded owner address and (incorrectly) is declared view while assigning _horn_pool.
ERC20._transfer internal: moves balances between accounts and emits Transfer.
ERC20._mint internal: increases _totalSupply and credits _balances for an account.
ERC20._approve internal: writes the _allowances mapping and emits Approval.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller used as sender, lottery entrant and randomness seed.
block.timestamp (referenced as now): miner-influenced value used as the randomness seed in getRandom.
IERC20(address(this)).transfer(fees_receiver, total_collected) in randomize: external call performed before state is reset.
Pseudo-random winner selection from now/msg.sender hashing, enabling manipulation of the payout receiver.
Assignment to _horn_pool inside a function declared view, making the only privileged state write ineffective.
rhinoToken.transfer recipient address parameter.
rhinoToken.transfer amount parameter.
Local total_fees = amount.mul(1).div(50) (2% fee) computed in transfer.
Local amountAfterDeductingFees = amount.sub(total_fees) transferred to the recipient.
rhinoToken.randomize _fees parameter carrying the contract-side fee share.
Local fees_receiver chosen from last_transacters[getRandom()] as the lottery winner.
Local randomnumber = uint(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(now, msg.sender))) % 9.
Constructor parameter _horn_pool_ assigned to the _horn_pool state variable.
Constructor parameter tokenOwnerAddress receiving the initial minted supply.
changeHornPool parameter _horn_pool intended to replace the fee pool address.
ERC20._transfer sender address parameter.
ERC20._transfer recipient address parameter.
ERC20._transfer amount parameter.
ERC20._mint account parameter credited with new tokens.
ERC20._mint amount parameter added to the supply.
ERC20._approve owner address parameter.
ERC20._approve spender address parameter.
ERC20._approve value parameter stored as the allowance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender argument of the fee-charging transfer override.
recipient parameter flows into the token transfer target.
amount parameter drives the fee and net transfer computation.
amount is multiplied and divided to derive total_fees.
total_fees is subtracted from amount to derive amountAfterDeductingFees.
amount participates directly in the subtraction producing the post-fee amount.
transfer invokes the internal ERC20._transfer for each payout leg.
transfer indirectly mutates the _balances mapping through _transfer.
transfer credits half of the fee to the _horn_pool address.
transfer calls randomize on every token movement.
total_fees.div(2) is passed as the _fees argument to randomize.
randomize reads, deletes and pushes into last_transacters.
A stored sender from last_transacters becomes fees_receiver.
randomize accumulates and resets total_collected.
randomize calls getRandom to index the participant array.
_fees parameter is added into total_collected.
msg.sender is recorded into last_transacters and seeds the randomness.
randomize performs the external token transfer that constitutes the unsafe operation.
The self-directed ERC20 transfer mutates the _balances mapping during randomize.
The external call to this contract can re-enter randomize before last_transacters and total_collected are reset.
total_collected is zeroed only after the external call, allowing fee-drain reentrancy.
last_transacters is delete()d only after the external call, so re-entry observes stale state.
getRandom consumes block.timestamp (now) as part of its seed.
getRandom produces the weak randomness that drives the lottery payout operation.
Miner-controllable block.timestamp influences which address receives the collected fees.
Caller-controlled msg.sender can be brute-forced to bias the winner selection.
getRandom returns the derived randomnumber local variable.
msg.sender is packed into the keccak256 seed of getRandom.
msg.sender is compared against the hardcoded privileged address in changeHornPool.
_horn_pool parameter is meant to update the fee pool storage slot.
changeHornPool attempts to overwrite the privileged _horn_pool address.
changeHornPool contains the guarded but view-restricted pool write.
The view-declared write to _horn_pool cannot take effect, leaving the privileged setter broken.
The pool write is gated solely by a msg.sender equality check against one literal address.
Constructor parameter _horn_pool_ initializes the _horn_pool state variable.
Constructor calls _mint to create the entire initial supply.
tokenOwnerAddress receives the minted supply.
_totalSupply is the amount passed into the mint call.
_transfer debits the sender parameter.
_transfer credits the recipient parameter.
_transfer moves the given amount between balances.
_transfer rewrites entries of the _balances mapping.
_mint credits the account parameter.
_mint increases balances and supply by the amount parameter.
_mint conceptually increases the tracked total supply.
_approve keys the allowance mapping on the owner parameter.
_approve keys the allowance mapping on the spender parameter.
_approve stores the value parameter as the allowance.
_approve writes the _allowances nested mapping.
_mint writes the _balances mapping.
The fee transfer leg routes part of the amount into the _horn_pool balance.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only exists to feed the transfer override and collapses into that function node.
The amount parameter only exists to feed the transfer override and collapses into that function node.
total_fees is a temporary inside transfer and adds no distinct semantic entity.
amountAfterDeductingFees is a temporary inside transfer and adds no distinct semantic entity.
The _fees parameter is only meaningful within the randomize fee accumulation logic.
fees_receiver is the locally selected payout target inside randomize.
randomnumber is the sole return-local of getRandom and merges into it.
The pool address argument is consumed only by the constructor initialization.
The owner address argument is consumed only by the constructor minting.
The pool parameter feeds only the guarded setter function.
Sender is a formal parameter of the internal ERC20._transfer routine.
Recipient is a formal parameter of the internal ERC20._transfer routine.
Amount is a formal parameter of the internal ERC20._transfer routine.
Account is a formal parameter of the internal ERC20._mint routine.
Amount is a formal parameter of the internal ERC20._mint routine.
